transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. I guess what brings me in is... well, my eating has just gotten really off lately. Some days, honestly, I barely get down a cup of coffee and maybe a granola bar before my shift. And I've noticed my scrubs have been hanging pretty loose on me, even though I'm definitely not trying to lose any weight. I just don't really have much of an appetite.
Are you avoiding food because you’re worried about gaining weight?

No, it's not about my weight at all. I really don't care about that, and like I said, I'm not trying to lose any. I just... I don't know, I just don't have the desire to eat. The thought of food just doesn't appeal to me right now.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah, I have. Honestly, most mornings I wake up with this... this heavy, hollow feeling. It just feels like the day is already ruined before I even put on my badge for work. So, yes, I've definitely been feeling pretty down.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to really like going for runs in Van Cortlandt Park, and I'd take photos while I was out there. I also used to play chess with some friends pretty regularly. But lately... I don't know, I just tell myself there's no point to any of it. I end up just sitting at home, scrolling on my phone or looking over my budget spreadsheet instead of doing the things I used to like.
Have you been having thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?

I haven't made any kind of plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But... I do catch myself wishing I just wouldn't wake up sometimes. Or I just think it would be a lot easier if I just disappeared. I don't know, it's just this feeling that life isn't really worth all the effort right now.
Did something stressful happen in your life around the time these symptoms started?

Well, yeah. I guess it all started when my clinic did this massive overhaul of our electronic medical records system and changed up the whole workflow. They ended up changing my hours because of it. That was... almost two years ago now. It's just been going on since then.
When you're away from work for a few days, do you still feel this down?
Yeah, I do. Even if I have a long weekend or take some time off, it doesn't really change anything. The feeling just... stays with me, no matter where I am or what day it is.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge a lot lately?
No, not really. I mean, I don't feel particularly anxious or nervous about things. I'm just mostly feeling down and drained, like I said. I don't really get that on-edge feeling.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah, actually. My sleep is pretty broken up. I'll just lie there for a while, replaying things from work in my head and... kind of just listening for noises. And then, when I finally do get to sleep, I usually end up waking up around 3 or 4 in the morning. Once I'm up, I just can't seem to settle back down before my alarm goes off.
When you think about eating, do you avoid food because the taste, texture, or fear of nausea or choking puts you off?

No, it's not really like that. I don't have any issues with textures or being afraid of choking or anything. I just... I don't really have much of an appetite lately, but it's not because I'm avoiding the food itself for those reasons.
